articles.title_en: Local Retail Prices, Product Variety, and Neighborhood Change
articles.title_cn: 本地零售价格、产品多样性与社区变迁
articles.abstract_en: We study how local grocery markets within a city are affected by changes in housing markets. Our empirical strategy exploits a shift in the spatial distribution of construction activity induced by a large-scale, place-based tax exemption in the city of Montevideo. The introduction of new housing stock induced by the policy causes a reduction in grocery prices of 2.3 percent and an increase in locally available product varieties. Using insights from a multiproduct model of imperfect competition and estimates for different types of stores, we show these changes are the result of incumbents’ response to an increase in local demand. (JEL L81, O18, R22, R23, R31, R38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究城市内本地食品杂货市场如何受到住房市场变化的影响。我们的实证策略利用了蒙得维的亚市一项大规模、基于地方的税收豁免所引发的建筑活动空间分布变化。该政策引入的新住房存量导致食品杂货价格下降2.3%，并增加了本地可获取的产品种类。利用多产品不完全竞争模型的见解以及对不同类型商店的估计，我们表明这些变化是现有企业对本地需求增加的反应结果。(JEL L81, O18, R22, R23, R31, R38)

articles.title_en: Behavioral Responses to State Income Taxation of High Earners: Evidence from California
articles.title_cn: 高收入者对州所得税的行为反应：来自加利福尼亚州的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using administrative data, we analyze the response to Proposition 30, a 2012 measure that increased California marginal tax rates by up to 3 percentage points for high-income households. Relative to baseline departure rates, an additional 0.8 percent of the residential tax base that landed in the top bracket left California in 2013. Using matched out-of-state taxpayers as controls reveals an income elasticity with respect to the marginal net-of-tax rate of 2.5–3.2 for high earners who stayed. These responses eroded 45.2 percent of state windfall tax revenues within the first year and 60.9 percent within 2 years, driven largely by the intensive margin. (JEL D91, H24, H31, H71, H73, J61, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用行政数据分析了对提案 30 的响应，该提案 2012 旨在将加州高收入家庭的边际税率提高高达 3 个百分点。相对于基线离开率，2013 中位于最高等级的住宅税基的额外 0.8% 离开了加利福尼亚州。使用匹配的州外纳税人作为对照，揭示了留下来的高收入者相对于2.5-3.2边际净税率的收入弹性。这些应对措施在第一年侵蚀了州暴利税收收入的45.2%，并在2年内侵蚀了60.9%，这主要是由于集约利润率的推动。 （JEL D91、​​H24、H31、H71、H73、J61、R23）

articles.title_en: Hassle Costs versus Information: How Do Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs Reduce Opioid Prescribing?
articles.title_cn: 麻烦成本与信息：处方药监测计划如何减少阿片类药物处方？
articles.abstract_en: We study hassle costs versus information provision in explaining how prescription drug monitoring programs (PDMPs) decrease opioid prescribing. PDMPs aim to reduce opioid prescribing through information provision but may also unintentionally affect prescribing through the hassle of required record checks. We analyze Kentucky’s landmark PDMP to disentangle these two mechanisms. Hassle costs reduce opioid prescribing across the board, including to opioid-naïve patients; however, physicians continue to prescribe opioids to patients who would benefit the most. Although information also affects prescribing, hassle costs explain the majority of the decline. Introducing a cost to prescribing high-risk medications improves the targeting of treatment. (JEL H75, I11, I12, I18, L65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究麻烦成本与信息提供在解释处方药监测计划（PDMPs）如何减少阿片类药物处方中的作用。PDMPs旨在通过信息提供减少阿片类药物处方，但也可能通过要求记录检查的麻烦无意中影响处方。我们分析肯塔基州具有里程碑意义的PDMP以区分这两种机制。麻烦成本全面减少阿片类药物处方，包括对阿片类药物初治患者；然而，医生继续为最受益的患者开具阿片类药物。尽管信息也影响处方，但麻烦成本解释了大部分下降。对高风险药物处方引入成本改善了治疗的针对性。（JEL H75, I11, I12, I18, L65）

articles.title_en: Fighting Crime in Lawless Areas: Evidence from Slums in Rio de Janeiro
articles.title_cn: 在无法治地区打击犯罪：来自里约热内卢贫民窟的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use Rio de Janeiro’s slum pacification program initiated in 2008 to analyze the effect of policies targeting crime in lawless areas. We correct the bias from the unobserved rise in crime reporting via the use of a proxy variable and bounded variation assumptions. We find that the program reduced the murder and robbery rates but strongly increased the assault and threat rates. We explain these results by providing evidence that increased enforcement weakened the security service that gangs provide on their turf, and may incentivize criminals to switch from serious to less serious crimes. (JEL H76, K14, K42, O17, O18, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用里约热内卢于2008年启动的贫民窟安抚计划，分析针对无法治地区犯罪的政策效果。我们通过使用代理变量和有界变化假设，纠正了未观测到的犯罪报告增加所带来的偏差。我们发现该计划降低了谋杀和抢劫率，但显著增加了袭击和威胁率。我们通过提供证据解释这些结果：加强执法削弱了帮派在其地盘上提供的安保服务，并可能激励罪犯从严重犯罪转向较轻犯罪。（JEL H76, K14, K42, O17, O18, R23）

articles.title_en: Does Health-Care Consolidation Harm Patients? Evidence from Maternity Ward Closures
articles.title_cn: 医疗整合是否损害患者利益？来自产科病房关闭的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how closures of maternity wards affect maternal and neonatal health. Using data on all hospital births in Sweden between 1990 and 2004, we compare changes in birth-related outcomes across hospital catchment areas that were differently exposed to ward closures. Our findings show that the closures increased maternal obstetric trauma but also decreased fetal stress and infant trauma among newborns. Adverse maternal outcomes are mainly driven by ward overcrowding, whereas increases in travel distance have no distinguishable effects. Positive effects on infant health reflect a shift of births from smaller to larger wards of higher quality. (JEL D24, G34, I11, I12, I18, J13, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了产科病房关闭对孕产妇和新生儿健康的影响。利用1990年至2004年间瑞典所有医院分娩的数据，我们比较了受病房关闭影响程度不同的医院 catchment 区域中分娩相关结果的变化。我们的研究结果表明，关闭病房增加了孕产妇产科创伤，但也减少了新生儿的胎儿窘迫和婴儿创伤。不良的孕产妇结局主要由病房过度拥挤驱动，而旅行距离的增加没有显著影响。对婴儿健康的积极影响反映了分娩从较小病房向质量更高的较大病房的转移。(JEL D24, G34, I11, I12, I18, J13, J16)

articles.title_en: Attendance Boundary Policies and the Limits to Combating School Segregation
articles.title_cn: 入学边界政策与消除学校隔离的局限性
articles.abstract_en: What is the efficacy of redrawing school attendance boundaries as a desegregation policy? To provide causal evidence on this question, we employ novel data with unprecedented detail on the universe of Danish children and exploit changes in attendance boundaries over time. Households defy reassignments to schools with lower socioeconomic status. There is a strong social gradient in defiance, as resourceful households are more sensitive to the student composition of new schools. We simulate school assignment policies and find that boundary changes that reassign areas to a highly disadvantaged school are ineffective at altering the socioeconomic composition at the disadvantaged school. (JEL D31, H75, I21, I24, I28, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 重新划定学校入学边界作为一项消除隔离政策的效力如何？为了就这一问题提供因果证据，我们使用了覆盖丹麦儿童总体且细节前所未有的新数据，并利用了入学边界随时间的变化。家庭会抵制被重新分配到社会经济地位较低的学校。抵制行为存在显著的社会梯度，因为资源丰富的家庭对新高中的学生构成更为敏感。我们模拟了学校分配政策，发现将区域重新分配到高度弱势学校的边界变化，在改变弱势学校的社会经济构成方面是无效的。(JEL D31, H75, I21, I24, I28, R23)

articles.title_en: Labor Supply Responses to Income Taxation among Older Couples: Evidence from a Canadian Reform
articles.title_cn: 老年夫妇对所得税的劳动供给反应：来自加拿大改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: I assess whether the tax code is a viable policy lever for influencing labor supply among older workers. Specifically, using administrative data from Canada, I estimate the earnings responses to a unique reform that lowered tax burdens for couples with a pensioner, using quasi-experimental methods. I find that workers decrease labor supply as tax bills decline but do not respond to changes in marginal tax rates. Hence, while public policy often aims to keep people in the workforce longer, there are conflicting effects of offering tax advantage for seniors on work incentives. I consider implications of these results for age-dependent taxation. (JEL H24, H31, H55, J14, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 我评估税收法规是否是影响老年工人劳动供给的可行政策杠杆。具体而言，利用加拿大的行政数据，我使用准实验方法估计了对有养老金领取者的夫妇降低税收负担的独特改革所带来的收入反应。我发现，随着税收账单减少，工人会减少劳动供给，但对边际税率的变化没有反应。因此，尽管公共政策通常旨在让人们更长时间地留在劳动力队伍中，但为老年人提供税收优惠对工作激励存在相互矛盾的影响。我考虑了这些结果对年龄相关税收的影响。（JEL H24, H31, H55, J14, J22）

articles.title_en: Increasing the Retirement Age: Policy Effects and Underlying Mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 提高退休年龄：政策效应与内在机制
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of increasing the statutory retirement age (SRA) in the Netherlands, using regression discontinuity design and administrative data on the universe of the population. We find clear and large employment effects of the reform. A simple model in which individuals stay longer in their pre-SRA labor market state predicts the treatment effects well. The employment level before the SRA and the retirement hazard at the SRA are the key determinants of the effects of the policy change. Exploring potential explanations for the high hazard rate observed in the Netherlands, our results point to an important role for employers’ effects. (JEL H55, J14, J26, J32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用断点回归设计和覆盖全人口的行政数据，研究了荷兰提高法定退休年龄（SRA）的影响。我们发现改革产生了明显且巨大的就业效应。一个简单的模型，即个体在达到法定退休年龄前维持原有劳动力市场状态，能够很好地预测处理效应。法定退休年龄前的就业水平和法定退休年龄时的退休风险是政策变化效应的关键决定因素。在探究荷兰观察到的较高退休风险率的潜在解释时，我们的结果指出了雇主效应的重要作用。（JEL H55, J14, J26, J32）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Improving Access to Support Services for Victims of Domestic Violence on Demand for Services and Victim Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 改善家庭暴力受害者获得支持服务的机会对服务需求及受害者结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a randomized controlled trial of an intervention designed to assist victims of domestic violence in accessing nonpolice support services. The intervention led to a 22 percent decrease in the fraction of victims providing a witness statement to police. Witness statements are an important piece of evidence and a key input in the prosecution of perpetrators. Despite this, we do not find a significant change in perpetrator arrests and convictions or in reported future violence. Survey responses provide evidence of an increase in nonpolice service use and a reduction in future victimization risk, but also a potential decrease in short-run well-being. (JEL H75, I31, J12, K14, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们针对一项旨在协助家庭暴力受害者获取非警方支持服务的干预措施进行了随机对照试验。该干预措施导致向警方提供证人陈述的受害者比例下降了22%。证人陈述是重要证据，也是起诉施暴者的关键投入。尽管如此，我们并未发现施暴者被捕率和定罪率或报告的未来暴力事件发生显著变化。调查回复提供了非警方服务使用增加和未来受害风险降低的证据，但也可能表明短期幸福感有所下降。(JEL H75, I31, J12, K14, K42)

articles.title_en: Regulating Privacy Online: An Economic Evaluation of the GDPR
articles.title_cn: 在线隐私监管：GDPR的经济评估
articles.abstract_en: Modern websites rely on personal data to design better content and to market themselves. The European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) was intended to make access to such personal data more difficult, with the goal of protecting user privacy. We examine the GDPR's impact on website page views and revenue for 1,084 online firms using data from Adobe's website analytics platform. We find a reduction of 12 percent in both EU user website page views and website revenue recorded by the platform after the GDPR’s enforcement deadline. We decompose these GDPR effects into changes in real outcomes and changes to data recording, respectively. (JEL D83, K24, L51, L86, L88, M31, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 现代网站依赖个人数据来设计更好的内容并进行自我营销。欧盟的《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）旨在使获取此类个人数据更加困难，以保护用户隐私。我们利用Adobe网站分析平台的数据，考察了GDPR对1,084家在线企业网站页面浏览量和收入的影响。我们发现，在GDPR执行截止日期后，欧盟用户的网站页面浏览量和平台记录的收入均减少了12%。我们将这些GDPR效应分别分解为实际结果的变化和数据记录的变化。（JEL D83, K24, L51, L86, L88, M31, M37）

articles.title_en: The Introduction of the Income Tax, Fiscal Capacity, and Migration: Evidence from US States
articles.title_cn: 所得税的引入、财政能力与迁移：来自美国各州的证据
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate how fiscal capacity and migration respond to the introduction of the individual income tax, drawing on new panel data on US states from 1900 to 2010. We find that the introduction of the income tax increased revenue per capita by 12 percent in the short term, 15 percent in the medium term, and 17 percent in the long term. The absolute level of revenue, however, did not significantly change over the long term for post–World War II adopters. To explain this, we show that the introduction of the income tax induced significant outmigration to non-income-tax states by middle- and high-earning households. (JEL H71, H73, N32, N42, N92, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用1900年至2010年美国各州的新面板数据，评估了个人所得税的引入如何影响财政能力和迁移。我们发现，所得税的引入在短期内使人均收入增加了12%，中期增加了15%，长期增加了17%。然而，对于二战后采用所得税的州，收入的绝对水平在长期内并未显著变化。为解释这一点，我们表明，所得税的引入导致中高收入家庭大量迁往不征收所得税的州。（JEL H71, H73, N32, N42, N92, R23）

articles.title_en: Experimental Evidence on the Effectiveness of Nonexperts for Improving Vaccine Demand
articles.title_cn: 非专家提升疫苗需求有效性的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally vary signals and senders to identify which combination will increase vaccine demand among a disadvantaged population in the United States—Black and White men without a college education. Our main finding is that laypeople (nonexpert concordant senders) are most effective at promoting vaccination, particularly among those least willing to become vaccinated. This finding points to a trade-off between the higher qualifications of experts on the one hand and the lower social proximity to low-socioeconomic-status populations on the other hand, which may undermine credibility in settings of low trust. (JEL D82, H51, I11, I12, I14, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验改变信号和发送者，以确定哪种组合能提高美国弱势群体——未受过大学教育的黑人和白人男性——的疫苗需求。我们的主要发现是，普通人（非专家同质发送者）在促进疫苗接种方面最为有效，尤其是在那些最不愿意接种的人群中。这一发现指出了专家资质较高与低社会经济地位人群社会距离较近之间的权衡，后者可能在低信任环境中削弱可信度。（JEL D82, H51, I11, I12, I14, J15）

articles.title_en: Addressing Environmental Justice through In-Kind Court Settlements
articles.title_cn: 通过实物法庭和解解决环境正义问题
articles.abstract_en: In US environmental court cases, a cash penalty can be mitigated if a defendant volunteers to undertake an in-kind project, such as retrofitting school buses or building a public park. A goal of the policy is to address environmental justice concerns for low-income and minority populations, yet the historical record shows in-kind settlements most likely occur in cases involving high-income, majority-White communities. A choice experiment reveals that the public prefers in-kind settlements over cash, and a randomized survey reveals in-kind settlements improve the public’s view of a violating firm, consistent with our finding of positive stock market reactions to in-kind settlements. (JEL D63, H23, J15, K32, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国环境法庭案件中，如果被告自愿承担实物项目，如改造校车或建造公园，现金罚款可以减轻。该政策的一个目标是解决低收入和少数族裔人口的环境正义问题，但历史记录显示，实物和解最有可能发生在涉及高收入、白人占多数的社区的案件中。一项选择实验表明，公众更倾向于实物和解而非现金，一项随机调查显示，实物和解改善了公众对违规企业的看法，这与我们发现实物和解对股市有积极反应的结论一致。(JEL D63, H23, J15, K32, Q53, Q58)

articles.title_en: State Taxation of Nonresident Income and the Location of Work
articles.title_cn: 非居民收入的州级税收与工作地点选择
articles.abstract_en: Prior studies show that taxes matter for the residential locations of high-income earners. But states raise a significant share of revenue from nonresidents. Using variation in state tax rates, we provide causal evidence on the effect of the net-of-tax rate on the location of labor supply for professional golfers. State taxes induce high-income earners to shift employment to low-tax states without a residence change. The elasticity of working in a state is 0.34 and, consistent with the superstar phenomenon, increases with earnings. Our results suggest a novel margin of mobility responses for top earners: the spatial relocation of labor supply by nonresidents. (JEL H71, H73, J22, J44, J61, R23, Z22)
articles.abstract_cn: 先前的研究表明，税收对高收入者的居住地选择有影响。但各州从非居民那里筹集了相当大比例的收入。利用州税率的变化，我们提供了关于净税率对职业高尔夫球手劳动力供给地点影响的因果证据。州税促使高收入者在不变更居住地的情况下将就业转移到低税州。在某州工作的弹性为0.34，并且与超级明星现象一致，该弹性随收入增加而增大。我们的结果揭示了顶级收入者流动性反应的一个新维度：非居民劳动力供给的空间迁移。(JEL H71, H73, J22, J44, J61, R23, Z22)

articles.title_en: Corporate Taxation and Evasion Responses: Evidence from a Minimum Tax in Honduras
articles.title_cn: 公司税收与逃税反应：来自洪都拉斯最低税的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study corporate responses to a minimum income tax, using the universe of corporate tax filings in Honduras. The policy design allows us to separately estimate cost misreporting under profit taxation and the elasticity of reported revenue. Large corporations overreport true costs when taxed on profits. Taxing revenue leads to a substantial decrease in reported revenues: we estimate an elasticity in the range 0.35–1. The elasticity of revenue is attenuated when third-party information on the revenue of firms is available, suggesting misreporting plays an important role. Our results inform trade-offs when broadening tax bases to curb evasion. (JEL H25, H26, K34, L25, O14, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用洪都拉斯公司纳税申报的全样本，研究了公司对最低所得税的反应。政策设计使我们能够分别估计利润税下的成本虚报和报告收入的弹性。大公司在按利润征税时高报真实成本。对收入征税导致报告收入大幅下降：我们估计弹性在0.35-1范围内。当可获得企业收入的第三方信息时，收入弹性会减弱，这表明虚报起着重要作用。我们的结果为扩大税基以遏制逃税时的权衡提供了信息。(JEL H25, H26, K34, L25, O14, O17)

articles.title_en: Mandatory Retirement for Judges Improved the Performance of US State Supreme Courts
articles.title_cn: 法官强制退休改善了美国州最高法院的表现
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence on how mandatory retirement influences judge performance using reforms in US state supreme courts as a natural experiment. We find that introducing mandatory retirement improves court performance as measured by output (number of opinions) and legal influence (number of citations to opinions). While older judges are cited less than younger judges, the effect of mandatory retirement is larger than what is expected from a change in the age distribution. We find some evidence that the additional effect is due to selective attrition and that the presence of older judges reduces the performance of younger judges. (JEL H76, J14, J24, J26, K40)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用美国州最高法院的改革作为自然实验，提供了关于强制退休如何影响法官表现的经验证据。我们发现，引入强制退休提高了法院的表现，这通过产出（意见数量）和法律影响力（意见被引用的次数）来衡量。虽然年长法官被引用的次数少于年轻法官，但强制退休的影响大于仅从年龄分布变化所预期的效果。我们发现一些证据表明，额外的影响是由于选择性离职，并且年长法官的存在降低了年轻法官的表现。（JEL H76, J14, J24, J26, K40）
